image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a rusty agricultural plow resting on grassy ground. The image prominently features a large, black rubber tire with a metal rim in the foreground. Behind the wheel is the heavy, rusted metal frame of the plow. To the right, a curved, wedge-shaped metal blade (the share/moldboard) is visible, partially embedded in or resting on the soil. The background consists of dense green foliage and trees.
